label: presenter_A
prompt:
A candid photo taken on a phone at eye level, 16:9: a fictional woman in her late thirties with
shoulder-length dark blond hair tied back loosely, navy knitted top with a round neck, small silver
earrings, a tiny black clip-on microphone on her collar. She sits at a round oak table in a quiet
meeting room, looking straight into the lens with a calm, friendly expression, mouth closed. Behind
her, softly out of focus: a tall plant and a shelf of plain grey folders. One soft window light from
camera left, warm table lamp in the background, gentle shadow on the right side of her face. Real
skin texture with visible pores and a few freckles, no retouching, no make-up glamour. She sits in
the centre third of the frame, framed from mid-chest up.
